decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. It is within the time limit: TXN-007896 posted on 2026-09-16 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 43 days later, inside the 120-day limit. TXN-007896 posted at 2,613 cents (26.13 EUR) at Stonecrest Brasserie (MER-000029), a RESTAURANT. Its authorisation, AUTH-008105, was approved for 2,376 cents (23.76 EUR) by chip and PIN. No receipt is attached. The 23.76 EUR bill the cardholder mentions is their own claim, not a receipt from the merchant. The posted amount is 237 cents above the authorised amount. A restaurant may add up to 20% of the authorised amount as a tip, which here is 475.2 cents, so 237 cents is within that limit. Under amount-restaurant-tip, the difference counts as an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch, and the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The restaurant authorised 23.76 EUR and posted 26.13 EUR. The 2.37 EUR difference is less than 20% of the authorised amount (4.75 EUR), which is how much a restaurant may add as a tip, so it is treated as an agreed tip and not a charging error.
